records.name: Zapped Giants
records.objectives_text: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 15 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

records.name: Greatfather Winter is Here!
records.objectives_text: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.

records.name: Treats for Greatfather Winter
records.objectives_text: Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.

records.name: Twisted Evils
records.objectives_text: Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carving for Willow in Desolace.

records.name: Vyletongue Corruption
records.objectives_text: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon. Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge. Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.

records.name: Vyletongue Corruption
records.objectives_text: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon. Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge. Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Talendria in Nijel's Point.

records.name: Stolen Winter Veil Treats
records.objectives_text: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

records.name: You're a Mean One...
records.objectives_text: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the .

records.name: Legends of Maraudon
records.objectives_text: Recover the two parts of the :Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.

records.name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
records.objectives_text: Speak with Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.

records.name: The Scepter of Celebras
records.objectives_text: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras. Speak with him when the ritual is complete.

records.name: The Feast of Winter Veil
records.objectives_text: Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to Baine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

records.name: The Reason for the Season
records.objectives_text: Speak with Historian Karnik at the Explorer's League in Ironforge about the Feast of Winter Veil.

records.name: The Feast of Winter Veil
records.objectives_text: Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to Muradin Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

records.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
records.objectives_text: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.

records.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
records.objectives_text: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Keeper Marandis at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

records.name: Seeds of Life
records.objectives_text: Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.

records.name: The Pariah's Instructions
records.objectives_text: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

records.name: Shadowshard Fragments
records.objectives_text: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.

records.name: Shadowshard Fragments
records.objectives_text: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Archmage Tervosh in Theramore on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh.

records.name: Alterac Valley Graveyards
records.objectives_text: Assault a graveyard, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

records.name: The Graveyards of Alterac
records.objectives_text: Assault a graveyard, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

records.name: Towers and Bunkers
records.objectives_text: Capture an enemy tower, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

records.name: Towers and Bunkers
records.objectives_text: Destroy the banner at an enemy tower or bunker, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

records.name: The Quartermaster
records.objectives_text: Speak with the Stormpike Quartermaster.

records.name: Capture a Mine
records.objectives_text: Capture a mine that the Stormpike does not control, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

records.name: Speak with our Quartermaster
records.objectives_text: Speak with the Frostwolf Quartermaster.

records.name: Capture a Mine
records.objectives_text: Capture a mine, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

records.name: The Battle of Alterac
records.objectives_text: Enter Alterac Valley, defeat the Horde general Drek'thar, and then return to Prospector Stonehewer in the Alterac Mountains.

records.name: Proving Grounds
records.objectives_text: Travel to the Wildpaw Cavern located southeast of the main base in Alterac Valley and find the Frostwolf Banner. Return the Frostwolf Banner to Warmaster Laggrond.

records.name: Proving Grounds
records.objectives_text: Travel to the Icewing Caverns located southwest of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley and recover the Stormpike Banner. Return the Stormpike Banner to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.

records.name: Honored Amongst the Clan
records.objectives_text: It is good to see you again, . I had not expected you to return. Alas, you have proven yourself a brave and honorable soldier of the Frostwolf. Your time has come again, . You have earned a new ranking and as such, a new insignia denoting this rise in stature. Present your insignia.

records.name: The Last Element
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.

records.name: Armor Scraps
records.objectives_text: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Murgot Deepforge in Dun Baldar.

records.name: Enemy Booty
records.objectives_text: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Smith Regzar in Frostwolf Village.

records.name: In Defense of Frostwolf
records.objectives_text: Venture to Alterac Valley, located in the Alterac Mountains. Find and speak with Warmaster Laggrond - who stands outside the tunnel entrance - to begin your career as a soldier of Frostwolf. You will find Alterac Valley north of Tarren Mill at the base of the Alterac Mountains.

records.name: The Sovereign Imperative
records.objectives_text: Travel to Alterac Valley in the . Outside of the entrance tunnel, find and speak with Lieutenant Haggerdin. For the glory of Bronzebeard!

records.name: Brotherly Love
records.objectives_text: Travel into Stormpike territory and slay Commander Karl Philips. Return to Commander Louis Philips when the task is complete.

records.name: Brotherly Love
records.objectives_text: Travel into Frostwolf territory and slay Commander Louis Philips. Return to Commander Karl Philips when the task is complete.

records.name: Fallen Sky Lords
records.objectives_text: Travel to Frostwolf territory and search for Wing Commander Slidore, Wing Commander Vipore, and Wing Commander Ichman. Return to Commander Duffy should you complete your mission.

records.name: Fallen Sky Lords
records.objectives_text: Find out what became of Wing Commander Guse, Wing Commander Jeztor, and Wing Commander Mulverick. Return to Commander Mulfort should you complete your mission.

records.name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
records.objectives_text: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.

records.name: Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin
records.objectives_text: Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary. Return to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.

records.name: The Madness Within
records.objectives_text: You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated. Enter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum. Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete thi

records.name: Arcane Refreshment
records.objectives_text: Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.

records.name: Elven Legends
records.objectives_text: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache with whatever information that you may find.

records.name: Elven Legends
records.objectives_text: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.

records.name: A Hero's Reward
records.objectives_text: Claim your reward from Hydraxis' Coffer.

records.name: Attunement to the Core
records.objectives_text: Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment. Return to Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain when you have recovered the Core Fragment.

records.name: Lethtendris's Web
records.objectives_text: Bring Lethtendris' Web to Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

records.name: Lethtendris's Web
records.objectives_text: Bring Lethtendris's Web to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

records.name: Victory for the Horde
records.objectives_text: Take the Head of Onyxia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

records.name: For All To See
records.objectives_text: Seek out Overlord Runthak in the Valley of Strength.

records.name: Camp Mojache
records.objectives_text: Speak with Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

records.name: Feathermoon Stronghold
records.objectives_text: Speak with Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

records.name: Victory for the Alliance
records.objectives_text: Take the Head of Onyxia to King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind.

records.name: Celebrating Good Times
records.objectives_text: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes.

records.objectives_text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

records.name: The Emerald Dream...
records.objectives_text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

records.name: Nostro's Compendium
records.objectives_text: Return Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying to the Athenaeum.

records.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar

start.name: A Dull and Flat Elven Blade
start.page: A Dull and Flat Elven Blade

records.objectives_text: Give the Dull and Flat Elven Blade to Lorekeeper Lydros.

objectives.text: A Dull and Flat Elven Blade (Provided)

target.name: A Dull and Flat Elven Blade
target.page: A Dull and Flat Elven Blade

records.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
records.objectives_text: You must get Onyxia to breathe fire on the Unfired Ancient Blade. Once this is done, pick up the now Heated Ancient Blade. Be warned, a Heated Ancient Blade will not remain heated forever - time is of the essence. The last step before returning to me is to slay the beast and drive the Heated Ancient Blade into her corpse. Do this and Quel'Serrar will be yours.

records.name: Mor'zul Bloodbringer
records.objectives_text: Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer at the Altar of Storms in the Burning Steppes.

records.name: Rage of Blood
records.objectives_text: Bring 30 bottles of Raging Beast's Blood to Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

records.name: Wildeyes
records.objectives_text: Bring the Case of Blood to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

records.name: The Prison's Bindings
records.objectives_text: Travel to Dire Maul in Feralas and recover 15 Satyr Blood from the Wildspawn Satyr that inhabit the Warpwood Quarter. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when this is done.

records.name: The Prison's Casing
records.objectives_text: Travel to Darkwhisper Gorge in Winterspring and recover 5 Tears of the Hederine from the Hederine demons that occupy the gorge. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when you have completed this task.

records.name: Suppression
records.objectives_text: Venture forth into the Tainted Scar and locate a Doomguard Commander. Use the Glowing Crystal Prison on the Doomguard Commander. Be prepared for a ferocious onslaught of attacks, as the demon attempts to escape capture. Should you succeed, return the Imprisoned Doomguard to Daio in the Tainted Scar.

records.name: What Niby Commands
records.objectives_text: Speak with Impsy in Felwood.

records.name: Flawless Fel Essence
records.objectives_text: Impsy in Felwood has asked that you bring him three Flawless Fel Essences originating from three distinct locations. The Legashi Satyrs of Azshara hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Jaedenar Legionnaires of Jaedenar hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Felguard Sentries of the Blasted Lands hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. Recover the Flawless Fel Essenc

records.name: A Binding Contract
records.objectives_text: Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.

records.name: The Balance of Light and Shadow
records.objectives_text: Save 50 Peasants before 15 are slain. Speak with Eris Havenfire should you accomplish this task. You may view the Death Post to view how many Peasants have been slain.

objectives.text: The Balance of Light and Shadow

wiki.page: The Balance of Light and Shadow (quest)

records.name: Lord Banehollow
records.objectives_text: Purchase Shadowy Potions from Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes. Use the potions to travel through Jaedenar, and speak with Lord Banehollow.

records.name: Ulathek the Traitor
records.objectives_text: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.

records.name: Xorothian Stardust
records.objectives_text: Purchase Xorothian Stardust from Ur'dan inside the Shadow Hold at Jaedenar in Felwood. Bring it to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

records.name: Bell of Dethmoora
records.objectives_text: Bring 2 Elixirs of Shadow Power to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

records.name: Wheel of the Black March
records.objectives_text: Bring 6 Large Brilliant Shards and 25 Dark Iron Ore to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.

records.name: Doomsday Candle
records.objectives_text: Bring 3 Black Dragonscales to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

records.name: Imp Delivery
records.objectives_text: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance. After the parchment is created, return the jar to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.

records.name: Arcanite
records.objectives_text: Bring 1 Arcanite Bar to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Bell of Dethmoora (quest) , Doomsday Candle , Wheel of the Black March

records.name: Dreadsteed of Xoroth
records.objectives_text: Read Mor'zul's Instructions. Summon a Xorothian Dreadsteed, defeat it, then bind its spirit to you.

records.name: The Ancient Leaf
records.objectives_text: Find the owner of the Ancient Petrified Leaf. Good luck, ; It's a big world.

records.name: Ancient Sinew Wrapped Lamina
records.objectives_text: Hastat the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Blue Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Hastat in Felwood.

records.name: A Proper String
records.objectives_text: Stoma the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Black Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Stoma in Felwood.

records.name: Stave of the Ancients
records.objectives_text: You must find and destroy these four demonic corrupters: Destroy these creatures and return to Vartrus the Ancient in Felwood with their heads. Refer to the Petrified Bark in your inventory for clues as to their whereabouts. You MUST complete this task by yourself.

records.name: Emphasis on Sacrifice
records.objectives_text: Travel to Ironforge and get High Priest Rohan's :Exorcism Censer. You will need to make a donation of 150 gold in order to secure it.

records.name: To Show Due Judgment
records.objectives_text: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

records.name: Exorcising Terrordale
records.objectives_text: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale. When you have slain 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

records.name: The Work of Grimand Elmore
records.objectives_text: Speak with Grimand Elmore in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

records.name: Collection of Goods
records.objectives_text: Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 Arthas' Tears, 5 Stratholme Holy Water vials, and 150 to Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

records.name: Ancient Equine Spirit
records.objectives_text: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse. Merideth Carlson in Southshore apparently is the source for such food. Travel to the Dire Maul dungeon in Feralas and slay Tendris Warpwood. Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit. Feed it the special horse feed, thereby soothing the spirit. Finally, give it the Arcanite Barding so it may bless it.

records.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
records.objectives_text: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

records.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
records.objectives_text: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits - the key ingredient in making Manna-Enriched Horse Feed - for Merideth Carlson at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits. You also need to give her 50 gold to soothe her ruffled sensibilities.

records.name: The Divination Scryer
records.objectives_text: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

records.name: Judgment and Redemption
records.objectives_text: Use the :Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver. Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger. Give the :Charger's Redeemed Soul and the :Blessed Arcanite Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.

records.name: Grimand's Finest Work
records.objectives_text: Take the Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District for his inspection.

records.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume I
records.objectives_text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

records.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume II
records.objectives_text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

records.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume III
records.objectives_text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

records.name: Imperial Plate Belt
records.objectives_text: For the belt plans, I'll be needin' 10 thorium bars.

records.name: Imperial Plate Boots
records.objectives_text: For the boot plans, I'll be needin' 20 thorium bars. Yep, 20. Are you gonna cry? Would you like a hanky?

records.name: Imperial Plate Chest
records.objectives_text: For the chest piece plans, I'll be needin' 30 thorium bars. Oh boy, there you go again. Are you gonna be runnin' to yer blue Gods, askin' why they have forsaken you?!? Toughen up, Nancy! Nobody ever said life's fair.

records.name: Imperial Plate Helm
records.objectives_text: Just hand over 25 thorium bars and the helm plans are yers.

records.name: Imperial Plate Leggings
records.objectives_text: Just hand over 30 thorium bars and the leg plans are yers. I know, I'm driving you into bankruptcy! I've heard it all before so you can save your sob story, weakling.

records.name: Imperial Plate Shoulders
records.objectives_text: For the shoulder plans, I'll be needin' 10 thorium bars.

records.name: Material Assistance
records.objectives_text: If you are interested in helping Sagorne Crestrider in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, bring him an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond.

records.name: The Darkreaver Menace
records.objectives_text: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth spirits you must fight. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver; defeat him. Bring Darkreaver's Head to Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar.

records.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
records.objectives_text: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

records.name: WANTED: Overseer Maltorius
records.objectives_text: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named Overseer Maltorius. Slay Overseer Maltorius and take his head. Return the head to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker in the Searing Gorge for your reward.

records.name: Unfinished Gordok Business
records.objectives_text: Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.

records.name: Fuel for the Zapping
records.objectives_text: Collect 10 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

records.name: Fiery Menace!
records.objectives_text: Slay 20 Greater Lava Spiders.

records.name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
records.objectives_text: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs. You will find Incendosaurs occupying the lava pools inside the Slag Pit. The Slag Pit can be found in the Cauldron of the Searing Gorge. Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Incendosaurs.

wiki.page: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It

records.name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
records.objectives_text: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge. The only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The Smithing Tuyere is a blacksmithing tool used by blacksmiths and the Lookout's Spyglass is an invaluable monitoring tool to lookouts.

wiki.page: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass

records.name: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
records.objectives_text: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.

records.name: Zukk'ash Infestation
records.objectives_text: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

records.name: Zukk'ash Report
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore. He resides in the Drag of Orgrimmar.

records.name: Improved Quality
records.objectives_text: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Pratt McGrubben at Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.

records.name: Improved Quality
records.objectives_text: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

records.name: Blackhand's Command
records.objectives_text: That is one stupid orc. It would appear as if you need to find this brand and gain the Mark of Drakkisath in order to access the Orb of Command. The letter indicates that General Drakkisath guards the brand. Perhaps you should investigate.

records.name: The Lord of Blackrock
records.objectives_text: Return the Head of Nefarian to Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth in Stormwind.

records.name: The Lord of Blackrock
records.objectives_text: Venture to the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City and speak with Field Marshal Stonebridge.

records.name: The Lord of Blackrock
records.objectives_text: Return the Head of Nefarian to Eitrigg in Orgrimmar.

records.name: The Lord of Blackrock
records.objectives_text: Seek out Overlord Natoj in Orgrimmar. He stands waiting for you in the Valley of Strength.

records.name: Examine the Vessel
records.objectives_text: Examine the Vessel of Rebirth and return it to Highlord Demitrian.

records.name: Thunderaan the Windseeker
records.objectives_text: To free Thunderaan the Windseeker from his prison, you must present the right and left halves of the Bindings of the Windseeker, 10 bars of Enchanted Elementium, and the Essence of the Firelord to Highlord Demitrian in Silithus.

records.name: Rise, Thunderfury!
records.objectives_text: Present the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade to Highlord Demitrian.

records.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
records.objectives_text: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.

records.name: Quell the Silverwing Usurpers
records.objectives_text: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Alliance, gain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and bring it to Captain Shatterskull at the Mor'shan Base Camp.

records.name: Arena Master
records.objectives_text: Speak with Short John Mithril in the Stranglethorn Arena.

records.name: Avenging the Fallen
records.objectives_text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete. Markhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

records.name: Vilebranch Hooligans
records.objectives_text: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete. You recall Smith Slagtree mentioning that the tools might be at one of the Vilebranch temples in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands. You should also check Skulk Rock.

records.name: Message to the Wildhammer
records.objectives_text: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 8 Highvale Scouts, 5 Highvale Outrunners, 5 Highvale Rangers and 2 Highvale Marksman. Return to him when this task is complete. You can find the Highvale high elves at the Quel'Danil Lodge in the northwestern region of the Hinterlands.

records.name: Another Message to the Wildhammer
records.objectives_text: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 1 Long Elegant Feather from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete. Gryphons are known to inhabit every region of the Hinterlands.

records.name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer
records.objectives_text: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task is complete. Beware of angry Wildhammer dwarves and unruly members of the Alliance.

wiki.page: The Final Message to the Wildhammer

records.name: Cannibalistic Cousins
records.objectives_text: Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 6 Vilebranch Scalpers and 2 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete. Yayo'jin indicated that these trolls could be found near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples in the north by northeastern region of the Hinterlands.

records.name: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
records.objectives_text: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor. You have been told that he is being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital city located in the southern region of the Hinterlands.

records.name: Recover the Key!
records.objectives_text: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torntusk when you have recovered the key.

records.name: Return to Primal Torntusk
records.objectives_text: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.

records.name: Separation Anxiety
records.objectives_text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor. Markhor mentioned that his brother's remains were fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch. He also mentioned that there is a refuse pit filled with oozes in Jintha'alor as well as a wolf den. Both

records.name: Dark Vessels
records.objectives_text: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 5 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.

records.name: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions
records.objectives_text: You have been ordered to slay Vile Priestess Hexx and 5 Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards. See Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands once this task is complete. Vile Priestess Hexx and the Aman'zasi Guards can be found atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.

wiki.page: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions

records.name: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village
records.objectives_text: You have been tasked with the decimation of 5 Vilebranch Berserkers, 3 Vilebranch Shadow Hunters, 3 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers, and 2 Vilebranch Soul Eaters. Should you complete this task, return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

wiki.page: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village

records.name: The Treasure of the Shen'dralar
records.objectives_text: Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!

records.name: The Darkmoon Faire
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Free Ticket Voucher to Gelvas Grimegate, located inside the Darkmoon Faire.

records.name: The Darkmoon Faire
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Free Ticket Voucher to Gelvas Grimegate, located inside the Darkmoon Faire.

records.name: Waskily Wabbits!
records.objectives_text: Kill 5 rabbits and return to Jon LeCraft by the forge on Designer Island. Collect 10 Unlucky Wabbit Feet from the Waskily Wabbits.

records.name: Wabbit Pelts
records.objectives_text: Bring 3 LeCrafty Rabbit Pelts to Jon LeCraft.
